question: When does the recovered question dialog auto-continue on idle, what does it display, and which answers does it submit?
answer: Zbe enables the clock only with a non-null host timeout or CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS, resolves env ?? host ?? 60000 ms, clamps the countdown window to min(CLAUDE_AFK_COUNTDOWN_MS ?? 20000, timeout), and ticks once a second with elapsed = now - max(lastInteraction, base); a focused terminal moves base to now. ywe renders one right-aligned dim row `auto-continue in Ns · any key to stay` while remaining*1000 <= countdown. On elapsed >= timeout, sl fires once and P3 submits the answers map as-is, so only questions already answered are included. The product implements the same clock for grouped request dialogs, with a host-only afkTimeoutMs request field and the environment override.

behavior.enable: requested !== null || CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS defined; grouped question dialogs only
behavior.focusedBase: base = now whenever the terminal focus state is focused
behavior.remaining: elapsed >= timeout - countdown ? max(0, ceil((timeout - elapsed)/1000)) : ceil(timeout/1000)
behavior.display: auto-continue in {N}s · any key to stay when remaining*1000 <= countdown
behavior.submit: answers taken so far, keyed by group; unanswered questions are absent from the source map

adaptations: The recovered AskUserQuestion host supplies afkTimeoutMs through a dialog prop; the product exposes the same host-only field on TerminalPromptRequest while the model input keeps refusing the name as host_field.
The local askUserQuestionTimeout setting surface (Kdt/efo: 60s, 5m, 10m, never) is not ported; the environment variable and host field are the available triggers.
The screen-reader and external-racer gates have no state in this runtime and are treated as false, matching earlier host conventions.
The source builds the answer asynchronously and rechecks interaction/focus after the build; this host settles synchronously, so those checks reduce to clearing the one-second timer.
The countdown row reserves one frame content row and shifts the input cursor up by one; source styling is dim, while product frame rows carry no per-row style.
residuals: The askUserQuestionTimeout setting surface (60s/5m/10m/never) is not ported.
Screen-reader and external-racer enable gates have no host counterpart.
Question-level notes, chat-about-design, external-editor/image-paste and the full React renderer remain W43 work.
